name: GPU-Based Projected Tetrahedra
aliases: GPU Volume Scan Conversion of Tetrahedra
Tetrahedral Projection using Vertex Shaders (Wylie et al.)
definition: A practical approach for implementing Projected Tetrahedra for interactive volume rendering of unstructured data using programmable graphics cards, achieving interactive rates by storing the model in texture memory and avoiding redundant projections.
summary: GPU-Based Projected Tetrahedra is an interactive volume rendering method for unstructured tetrahedral data that uses a two-shader GPU architecture to avoid redundant projections and reduce memory usage.
